Bihar Govt Mandates State Approval for CBI Investigations

The Bihar government has decided that the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) will now require prior permission from the state government to initiate investigations against state government employees. This decision was announced by the state government. The move restricts the CBI's ability to conduct direct investigations within Bihar concerning state employees.
